jobs.occupation: Field Application Scientist (m/f/d) – Downstream Bioprocessing (Ingenieur/in - Biotechnologie)
jobs.description:
Job available in 8 locations: Bremen, Leipzig, Hannover, Remote, Düsseldorf, Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg

Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions
Office

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

BioProduction Group (BPG) at Thermo Fisher Scientific is dedicated to providing innovative solutions for bioproduction and bioprocessing. Our team focuses on developing and delivering high-quality products and services that support the manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals, vaccines, and cell and gene therapies.

Location
Germany or Austria, ideally based in the Frankfurt area or northern Germany, within convenient reach of a major airport or transportation hub.

Territory covers Germany and, depending on home location, Austria. Travel up to 50% across the assigned territory.

Discover Impactful Work
As a Field Application Scientist (FAS) (m/f/d) within the BioProduction Group, you will serve as a bioprocessing domain expert, helping biotechnology and biopharmaceutical customers accelerate technology adoption, process development, and optimization across downstream workflows.

You will engage with customers on a peer-to-peer, application-focused basis, providing technical leadership and process expertise before, during, and after the sale. Acting as a trusted advisor and problem solver, you will help customers achieve compliant, efficient, and high-performing processes using Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions. You will also play an important role in shaping future innovations by capturing and communicating Voice of Customer (VOC) insights.

A Day in the Life:
Serve as a technical expert and consultant, applying deep bioprocessing knowledge across purification, filtration, and single-use technologies. Engage with customers on a peer-to-peer basis to support process development, optimization, scale-up, and technology integration across downstream workflows.

Lead pre- and post-sales technical activities, including product evaluations, proof-of-principle (PoP) studies, technology qualification, and implementation in regulated environments. Contribute to pre-sales activities by delivering technical presentations on the features, benefits, and applications of POROS™ and CaptureSelect™ products, addressing downstream purification challenges and positioning Thermo Fisher Scientific capabilities against customer requirements.

What to expect:

- Provide comprehensive technical troubleshooting and act as an initial point of contact for product quality and performance issues, partnering with Quality, Field Service, and Technical Support to ensure timely and compliant resolution.
- Deliver technical training to internal and external audiences, including process scientists, engineers, and operators, to build capability and confidence in Thermo Fisher Scientific technologies and workflows.
- Conduct workflow consultations and GEMBA walks at customer sites to identify process improvement opportunities and align technical solutions with operational and business objectives.
- Support Bioprocessing Development Center (BDC) activities, customer trials, and on-site demonstrations, ensuring consistent technical messaging and execution excellence.
- Develop and execute customer technology adoption plans with measurable milestones, followed by utilization reviews to assess implementation, performance, and opportunities for further optimization.
- Document customer engagements and technical activities in Salesforce (SFDC), maintaining accurate records of activities, opportunities, win plans, technical risks, and mitigation actions.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Field Service Engineers, Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, and Quality/Regulatory teams to deliver seamless end-to-end customer outcomes.
- Capture, synthesize, and communicate Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to support product roadmaps, feature development, and best-practice content, including application notes, white papers, and case studies.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, workshops, webinars, and customer events, delivering workflow-based technical presentations and thought leadership.

Keys to Success:
Education

- BS, MS, or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, or a related scientific or engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant bioprocessing experience.

Experience

- 5+ years of hands-on bioprocessing experience, ideally within Process Development, with strong expertise in downstream processing.
- Demonstrated experience with downstream purification technologies, including chromatography, UF/DF, centrifugation, and related unit operations.
- Proven track record of technical engagement, process troubleshooting, and problem solving within Process Development and/or biomanufacturing environments.
- Experience supporting process scale-up, technology transfer, and process optimization from development through pilot and manufacturing scale.
- Hands-on experience with commonly used chromatography systems/skids at laboratory, pilot, and manufacturing scale, including the ability to operate systems and interpret data using commonly used chromatography software.
- Practical experience with column packing at small, pilot, and/or manufacturing scale.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Deep understanding of bioprocessing and downstream purification workflows, with the ability to translate scientific and engineering principles into practical customer solutions.
- Strong capability in process design, optimization, troubleshooting, and workflow consulting, using data-driven approaches to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Familiarity with Process Analytical Technology (PAT), Design of Experiments (DoE), and Quality by Design (QbD) principles, including relevant ICH Q8, Q9, and Q10 concepts.
- Knowledge of analytical methods used to support purification process development, including HPLC, ELISA, SDS-PAGE, and spectroscopy, with the ability to interpret and communicate analytical data.
- Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Excel and JMP; experience with scripting or additional analytical tools is an advantage.
- Strong technical writing, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with scientists, engineers, operators, and senior technical stakeholders.
- Strong problem-solving and influencing skills, with demonstrated effectiveness in cross-functional and matrixed environments.
- Experience using Salesforce.com (SFDC CRM) for customer engagement, opportunity, and activity tracking.
- Fluent in German and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.
- Based in Germany or Austria, ideally in the Frankfurt area or northern Germany, with convenient access to a major airport or transportation hub to support frequent travel across the assigned territory.
- Willing and able to travel up to 50%, primarily across Germany and, depending on home location, Austria.
- Valid driver’s license and passport, with the ability to travel as required within the territory.

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com)

jobs.occupation: Government Affairs Manager (f/m/d) (Politische/r Berater/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Government Affairs Manager at Siemens Energy, you will help shape the political, regulatory, and geopolitical environment in which we operate. You will translate policy developments into business opportunities, build trusted relationships with government stakeholders, and support Siemens Energy’s leadership in advancing the global energy transition.
Working closely with Business Areas, regional leadership (Hubs), and Executive Board Members, you will identify emerging political trends, assess risks and opportunities, and develop advocacy strategies that support the company’s growth agenda. You will be the interlink to and representative for selected HUBs and the corporate Government Affairs department. Your work will directly contribute to creating favorable market conditions for energy infrastructure, decarbonization technologies, grid modernization, and energy security solutions. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Monitoring and analysis of political, regulatory, and geopolitical developments
* Advocacy, stakeholder engagement, and relationship management across key public and industry stakeholders
* Political positioning and policy support aligned with Siemens Energy’s strategic priorities
* Identification of policy-driven business opportunities, including incentives, industrial policy, and funding programs
* Preparation of executive briefings, talking points, stakeholder dossiers, and strategic assessments
* Cross-functional coordination and external representation to strengthen Siemens Energy’s positioning in the global energy transition

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Political Science, Public Policy, International Relations, Economics, Law, or a related field
* Several years of professional experience in Government Affairs, Public Affairs, Public Policy, Regulatory Affairs, diplomacy, consulting, or related fields
* Strong understanding of European and international energy policy, industrial policy, and geopolitical developments
* Proven stakeholder management, analytical, strategic, and communication skills, including executive-level presentations and briefing materials
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced international environment, manage multiple priorities, and demonstrate high integrity and commitment to compliance
* Fluent English and good German; additional languages advantageous

About the Team

The Government Affairs department supports Siemens Energy's mission to become the world's most valued energy technology company. We connect business priorities with public policy, identify geopolitical risks and opportunities, and work with governments and institutions to promote energy security, industrial competitiveness, and decarbonization. Our team combines policy expertise, stakeholder engagement, geopolitical analysis, and strategic advocacy to create business value and enable long-term growth across global markets.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

We are Ryanair Engineering Germany GmbH

Based at Berlin Brandenburg Airport BER, we were founded in 2018 and are a 100% subsidiary of Ryanair.

The Irish airline group currently operates a fleet of 590 modern Boeing 737NG and MAX 10, Boeing 737-8200 Game Changer, and Airbus A320 aircrafts. We will continue to expand by more than 300 aircraft by 2030.

Requirements

- You hold an EASA Part 66 CAT B1 license with a Boeing-type rating

- Willing to work in shifts
- A valid EU/EEA passport with the unrestricted right to live and work in the European Union and a valid EU driver’s license
- Good command of written and spoken English
- Preferably, a valid German security clearance according to § 7 of the German Aviation Security Act

Benefits

- Direct and permanent employment with a German contract
- Career advancement opportunities within the Ryanair Group
- Payment of shift credits starting from 08:00 P.M.
- Working gear and tools
- Monthly charged Sodexo Shopping Card
- Free English & German courses for different levels

jobs.occupation: Staff Scientist as Parental Leave Replacement (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Single-cell Open Lab at the German Cancer Research Center is seeking, starting in January 2027, a Staff Scientist as Parental Leave Replacement.

The Single-cell Open Lab (scOpenLab) provides state-of-the-art infrastructure and scientific expertise for single-cell sequencing and spatial omics. Our goal is to enable researchers to perform advanced experiments independently: we advise users on experimental design, provide hands-on training, and support them throughout project optimization, experimental implementation, and library preparation.

Our technology portfolio covers a broad range of single-cell and multi-omic approaches, including single-cell RNA, DNA, and chromatin profiling, as well as spatial transcriptomics and spatial proteomics. Beyond providing access to established technologies, method development is an important part of our work. We continuously evaluate, adapt, and establish emerging single-cell and spatial technologies and develop customized experimental workflows. Examples include HIPSDR-seq for joint single-cell DNA and RNA profiling and the implementation of new spatial omics approaches. The scOpenLab is also closely involved in MultiSpace, the platform for spatial omics within the Health + Life Science Alliance Heidelberg Mannheim. Through MultiSpace, we collaborate with other technology platforms and research groups to enable multimodal spatial profiling and the integration of spatial transcriptomic, proteomic, and other molecular readouts.

Your Tasks

We are looking for a research scientist to cover a period of parental leave and join our interdisciplinary team. The position combines user support and training with hands-on experimental work and technology development, offering the opportunity to work at the forefront of rapidly evolving single-cell and spatial omics technologies with the following tasks:

- Planning and designing spatially resolved transcriptome and proteomics projects with our users
- Training of new users for spatial and single-cell omics assays
- Optimization and integration of new methods in the lab with a focus on multimodal approaches
- Organizing and driving early access programmes
- Scheduling and maintenance of service infrastructure for image-based spatial transcriptomics

Your Profile

- University degree in life science (MSc), additional PhD preferred
- Experience and very good knowledge of NGS techniques, library preparation, tissue handling, and imaging (skills in data analysis are a plus)
- Previous work in the single-cell field is certainly an advantage
- Very good knowledge of English and German
- Self-motivation and innovative thinking will be required for the successful implementation of your work. This also includes excellent communication and organizational skills.

Please provide both a CV and a cover letter.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

promote best practices Developing and implementing strategies to
increase brand awareness and attractiveness Creating core creative
ideas and campaigns to support our global brand strategy Defining
compelling brand stories based on deep consumer insights Close
collaboration with relevant country colleagues Depending on
experience, qualifications and organizational needs, the role may
include team leadership responsibility, contributing to the
development of franchise priorities, capability building, and the
successful delivery of business objectives These are the requirements
you should meet: Completed studies in marketing, business
administration, or similar experience Several years of experience in
brand management, ideally in the pharmaceutical or herbal sector
Proven track record in developing and implementing brand strategies
and campaigns Strong analytical skills and experience in conducting
market research Creativity combined with a strategic approach Ideally
first experiences with the "How Brands Grow" approach on
evidence-based marketing Ability to work in a dynamic international
environment and lead cross-functional teams (optional: previous
experience leading a team) Proficiency in English (both written and
spoken), basic German knowledge would be an advantage We offer you: A
globally operating, family-owned company with a commitment to social
responsibility Flexible working hours and home office options to
support the balance between work and personal life Responsible fields
of activity with a thorough onboarding process and performance-based
compensation with attractive social benefits and company pension
scheme Exciting prospects in a globally growing company with a wide
range of professional and personal development opportunities
Compensation – Global Brand Manager: Compensation is governed by the
company's collective bargaining agreement, which is aligned with the
German Chemical Industry Collective Pay Agreement (BETV Chemie). The
anticipated salary grades are: Global Brand Manager: pay grade E 10/6
K to E 12/6 K, depending on qualifications and professional experience
Senior Global Brand Manager: pay grade E 13 K The monthly gross salary
for a full-time position (39.5 hours / week) ranges from approximately
5.422 € (E 10/6 K) to 6.819 € (E 13 K), depending on the
applicable pay grade. In addition, employees may be eligible for an
above-tariff allowance, a performance-related bonus linked to target
achievement, and further benefits in accordance with company policies.
Compensation – Team Lead: This position is compensated outside the
scope of the collective bargaining agreement. The starting salary is
determined based on a current market benchmark and the candidate's
profile and is expected to range between 96.000 € and 105.000 €
gross salary per annum, depending on qualifications and experience. In
addition, employees are eligible for a performance-related bonus
linked to target achievement, as well as benefits in accordance with
company policies. Contact: Are you open to new opportunities? Then
take your chance. Please apply through our online application form. We

People & Organisation Theresa Frank www.bionorica.de

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d) (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
About Us TechMinds is an HR consultancy with a main focus on Tech &
IT. Your advantage: Through us, your application documents are sent
directly to the decision maker. In addition, you benefit from free
advice on all your career questions. And you get an authentic insight
into the daily work routine of your potential employer at an early
stage. Tasks You develop and improve the distributional forecasting
models of a growing software company in the grocery retail sector,
working across model architecture, calibration and coverage You deepen
existing production models, monitor forecast quality metrics
continuously and act quickly when performance degrades You identify
where current approaches reach their limits and shape what comes next
methodologically You make substantial contributions to the inventory
simulation and ordering policy framework and drive improvements
through to production You shape the technical direction in your focus
area, contribute to methodology decisions and hold a high bar for code
quality, testability and production readiness across the team You take
responsibility for end-to-end pipeline quality, from input data
integrity through forecast output to the performance of live order
recommendations, including regular backtesting and monitoring You ship
production-quality work with well-tested, readable and thoroughly
reviewed code, using agentic AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code,
Cursor) as part of your daily workflow You work closely with
engineering, product, sales and customer operations and translate
operational findings from store level into product improvements
Profile You hold an MSc or PhD in a quantitative field such as
statistics, mathematics, physics, operations research or computer
science You have built systems that make decisions under uncertainty
with real operational consequences, not just research prototypes Your
background is in at least one of probabilistic forecasting, stochastic
inventory simulation or operations research, with solid working
knowledge across the others You are deeply familiar with
distributional and probabilistic forecasting methods (e.g. quantile
regression, LGBM with distributional output, GAMLSS-type models,
conformal prediction) You have a solid grounding in stochastic
inventory theory, newsvendor models, related ordering policies and
service level optimisation You write production-grade Python and SQL
on large, messy, real-world data and have experience with ML model
evaluation and monitoring in production settings You are comfortable
working with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Vertex AI) and dbt, and you are
familiar with workflow orchestration (Airflow or Cloud Composer), Git,
containerisation and CI/CD You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude
Code, Cursor or similar) with daily fluency You translate complex
mathematical reasoning into decisions that product teams and
non-technical colleagues can act on You ideally bring experience from
supply chain optimisation, demand planning or retail, ideally combined
with startup or scale-up experience You are fluent in English; German
is not required Benefits You receive an attractive compensation
package including equity participation (VSOP) Home-Office
possibilities 30 vacation days You receive individual relocation
support if you are moving to Berlin Kontakt Further details apart from
the job description as well as information about the company are
available during the application process.
